city_center.name: Grand Central Market (Downtown LA) + the Original Farmers Market (Fairfax)
city_center.landmark: Grand Central Market (1917) downtown; the Original Farmers Market at 3rd and Fairfax; Spanish-Colonial and mid-century architecture; palms and the Hollywood Hills
city_center.notes: Los Angeles pairs Grand Central Market (a 1917 downtown food hall) and the Original Farmers Market (Fairfax) with year-round Southern California produce. Architecture ranges from Spanish-Colonial Revival to mid-century modern. sources: en.wikipedia.org Grand Central Market; farmersmarketla.com.
